t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There is not a specific pattern, but just ensure you press this space bar and the keys on the keyboard with enough time

vb_textbox.text: I tried different techniques to see if there was a pattern. I tended to score more points when it was a 5x multiplier using the 'k' and likewise when it was a 1x multiplier using the 's'. I would suggest tending to use the 'k', especially when it is a 5x multiplier.
